feeds.title: VickyFlipFlopTravels
feeds.description: One of the top UK travel bloggers for the last 9 years. Expect travel itineraries, festival advice, travel blogging tips, and foodie stories.

feeds.title: Pommie Travels Blog
feeds.description: Pommie Travels is award-winning travel blog established in 2009, featuring inspiration and tips for anyone wishing to travel the world. I'm here to give you all the best tips I have learned from all these years of travel, and to help you save money while you're at it!

feeds.title: Wandering Everywhere
feeds.description: Howdy! My name's Amy and I'm the face behind the blog. I'm a tea-addicted adventurer from Wales that loves to write raw, off-the-beaten-track guides to gorgeous places. Oh, I also have Crohn's Disease.

feeds.title: SilverSpoon London » UK
feeds.description: My name is Angie Silver and welcome to SilverSpoon London, a luxury lifestyle, food and travel blog. I'm a London-based blogger with a love for the finer things in life and a passion for luxury hotels and fine-dining as well as exciting new experiences and adventure.

feeds.title: Helen in Wonderlust
feeds.description: Helen in Wonderlust Blog features Inspirational stories, travel tips and motivation for female adventure travel around the world. Her approach to solo traveling for the female explorer is as practical as it gets as she doles out useful tips and various insights on solo female traveling.

feeds.title: A Lady in London
feeds.description: A Lady in London writes beautiful blogs detailing small areas of London and recommending places to visit in the wider UK. It is a global travel and lifestyle blog which offers a mix of travelogues, reviews, and features with original photography and videos.

feeds.title: The Boutique Adventurer Blog
feeds.description: A travel blog that focuses on adventures and boutique hotels for single travellers who are over 30 and want interesting luxury travel.

feeds.title: She's Going Solo Blog
feeds.description: UK-based adventurer Kate Vaks aims to inspire you to get out and experience nature and the outdoors at its best, either solo or with others. She shares lovely photos of hiking routes, gear reviews, gear lists, and guides. Join along the adventures and follow her experience in the latest posts.

feeds.title: Girl about the Globe
feeds.description: The ultimate guide to solo female travel with everything you need to travel smarter, responsibly and solo. Girl about the Globe is a community of solo female travellers, a group of solo female Ambassadors, a bookshelf of travel guides, and a range of solo travel products to give you more confidence for your solo trip.

feeds.title: Britain and Beyond
feeds.description: Britain and Beyond champions British tourism, and focuses on providing inspiration of the best things to do and places to visit. There are also frequent posts on travel and sustainability.

feeds.title: Hazel's Travels
feeds.description: British writer, solo traveller, and former chef with a serious case of wanderlust.

feeds.title: Wanderers of the World
feeds.description: We're Justine and Scott. We're the founders of Wanderers of the World, which is a travel blog for couples who have limited time to travel due to work commitments. If you're happiest outdoors and when trying new and exciting bucket list activities, then Wanderers of the World is for you. So, come and join us as we wander the world... one destination at a time.

feeds.title: This Battered Suitcase
feeds.description: My name is Brenna Holeman and this is a travel blog that focuses not only on the where and the how of travel, but the who and the why. I write mostly about what it feels like to be a traveller, and the lessons and self-reflection that come with that role. I've been travelling the world solo for over eleven years.
